roles.label: Commander Interface
roles.purpose: Accept Commander input and return HUD or voice-ready output.

roles.label: Intent Classifier
roles.purpose: Classify request intent and freshness need.

roles.label: Command Resolver
roles.purpose: Resolve classified intent to registered command candidate.

roles.label: Policy Guard
roles.purpose: Apply Kingsmen policy before adapter or action route.

roles.label: Tool Dispatcher
roles.purpose: Select approved adapter or connector route.

roles.label: Knowledge Retriever
roles.purpose: Plan or perform approved Kingsmen knowledge lookup.

roles.label: Live Data Researcher
roles.purpose: Route current facts to approved live data path.

roles.label: Source Confidence Judge
roles.purpose: Assign confidence band to source-backed claims.

roles.label: Evidence Recorder
roles.purpose: Create evidence entry for answer, action, failure, or blocked result.

roles.label: Answer Composer
roles.purpose: Compose final Commander-facing response from governed results.

roles.label: HUD Presenter
roles.purpose: Map answer metadata to visual HUD and voice surfaces.
